ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels to 20% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields across both lobes; thick black pigmentation bands along the leading edges and central notch region; distinct vertical linear black streaks on the distal right lobe; sparse black punctate spots distributed across the interior white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50-60 degrees; significant depth relative to the fluke's vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary; higher pixel-amplitude variations observed on the distal margins compared to the proximal margins near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges tapering to acute tips; concave curvature transition from the mid-lobe to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular low-intensity pixel clusters (scars) on the white ventral field; dense cluster of irregular, high-relief tan/yellow pixel blocks on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe indicating barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct horizontal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the lower right quadrant of the fluke lobe, crossing the natural radial pigmentation lines.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized mass of calcified material or barnacles on the right lobe tip; parallel linear scarring (rake marks) on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'drip-like' vertical black pigmentation streaks on the distal right lobe and thick diagonal banding on the distal left lobe.
